# Warden's Brand

A magic weapon: attunement by a class, and the statistics of the
weapon — damage, properties, mastery, weight. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: 5e_2024
  card-type: item
data:
  name: Warden's Brand
  category: Weapon (Longsword)
  rarity: Rare
  attunement: by a Paladin
  damage: 1d8 Slashing
  properties: Versatile (1d10)
  mastery: Sap
  weight: 3 lb.
  description: |
    You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

    As a Bonus Action, you can make the blade smoulder until the end of your next turn; a creature hit by it in that time takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage.
```
